StoryPocket · How it works

Open a social app and choose Share → StoryPocket. You can also paste a link or share a photo/video file. Direct downloads are not always available and some platforms impose restrictions. Files are saved in Download/StoryPocket. This app is not affiliated with social platforms. Save only content you are entitled to keep.
